events.title: CDW Q1 Earnings Meet, Revenues Rise Y/Y on Infrastructure & AI Adoption
events.body: CDW posts solid Q1 2026 with rising sales and steady EPS, as strong demand across segments and AI investments shape its 2026 outlook.

events.title: Flex Q4 Earnings & Revenues Beat Estimates, Rise Y/Y, Stock Up

events.title: ONTO Q1 Earnings Beat, Revenues Up Y/Y on Strong Semiconductor Demand

events.title: Sonos' Reports Q2 Loss, Revenues Beat Estimates, Stock Jumps
events.body: SONO posts Q2 revenue growth and narrower loss, as improving trends and strong execution mark a key turnaround for SONO.
